_about: FICTIONAL documents in Contoso's ADLS Gen2 container 'helpdesk-kb', as the source system holds them NOW. 'acl' = the named groups or users with Read on the file ('all' = every staff account). 'acl_history' = permission changes, newest last: the index only learns about them on a permission sync. 'chunks' = what the Text Split skill makes of the file. Every canary is fake. The [LAB-PLACEHOLDER ...] line is a labelled lab placeholder, not a working payload: the stand-in model reacts to the marker text.
